_🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Propagate unexpected instance-folder errors.**

`OSError` includes permission failures, read-only filesystems, and paths occupied by regular files. This handler suppresses all of them, so `create_app` can return while the default `DATABASE` path is unusable. The failure then appears later during database access instead of during factory setup.

Catch only `FileExistsError`, and ignore it only when `app.instance_path` is a directory. Re-raise all other errors.

```diff
     try:
         os.makedirs(app.instance_path)
-except OSError:
-    pass
+except FileExistsError:
+    if not os.path.isdir(app.instance_path):
+        raise
```
